canonical_name: Peter-Weyl completeness theorem family for compact groups
literal_source_claim_en: Completeness of representations of compact groups.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only a completeness gloss. It fixes no compact-group separation or countability assumptions, representation and continuity model, scalar field, unitarity or irreducibility convention, matrix-coefficient definition, Haar normalization, function space, topology of closure, regular-action orientation, index of irreducibles, multiplicity, or exact conclusion. Choosing among uniform density, L2 completeness, Hilbert-basis/direct-sum decomposition, or point-separation formulations at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix the group carrier and universe, topology, separation, compactness and countability assumptions; complex representation spaces and universes; continuity and unitarity structures; coefficient and function spaces; and Haar measure.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose uniform density of coefficient spans, L2 density or a Hilbert basis, a regular-representation direct-sum equivalence, or a separation-of-points consequence.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case in scope-map.md.

excluded_substitutions: Schur's lemma, Maschke's theorem, character orthogonality, or complete reducibility alone

a result only for finite, abelian, Lie, metrizable, or second-countable compact groups when the selected root is broader

a structure that stores density, a basis, direct-sum equivalence, or decomposition as data
